draft.subject: Building full-stack products at Nexorlio
draft.body:
Hi Nexorlio team,

Your note about keeping engineers close to architecture decisions rather than handing work through layers resonated with me. That's the kind of small, hands-on team I enjoy.

I've spent the last couple of years building products end to end, from React/Next.js interfaces to Node APIs, Postgres, and deployment. At Stride AI, I shipped production features across frontend and backend; independently, I built Captar to make LLM execution easier to control and trace. I noticed your worldwide-remote Junior Full-Stack Developer opening and would love to contribute.

Are you considering engineers based in India for this role?

Portfolio: https://devansh.aurat.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/8dazo

Best,
Devansh
